mode: CLAIM_VERIFICATION (Thompson 1917 override: verify the pre-scouted dataset, do not scout a new model)

territory.organism: bovid horn shape morphology (Ovis ammon, Ovis spp., Capra spp.)
territory.seed_landmark_paper: Thompson, D.W. (1917) On Growth and Form, Ch. XIII, pp. 612-634, Figs. 318-324
territory.governing_mechanism: Horns (ram, goat, Ovis ammon) are logarithmic spirals wound on a cone (a conical helicoid generated by gnomonic growth), differing between species by the spiral constants and torsion.

uniqueness_check.method: morphoeval/scout_literature.py --query 'bovid horn shape morphology logarithmic spiral' --taxon 'Ovis ammon' (slot 225 is outside campaign_100_slots.yaml, so the custom-query path was used) + grep of thompson/, models/, morphoeval/lean/loops/, morphoeval/math_kg_loops/
uniqueness_check.note: No thompson/claims/ directory, no datasets/thompson_1917/ directory and no Thompson1917_* Lean module existed on origin/main (fc7454cd8) at scout time. T1917-027 (shell spiral) is listed in the claim inventory as the sibling test but has no repo code to share yet.

named_dataset.title: Variation in the ontogenetic allometry of horn length in bovids along a body mass continuum
named_dataset.authors: Tidiere M, Gaillard J-M, Garel M, Lemaitre J-F, Toigo C, Pelabon C
named_dataset.api_endpoint: https://datadryad.org/api/v2/datasets/doi%3A10.5061%2Fdryad.qz612jmb4 (api.datadryad.org did not resolve from the cloud VM; datadryad.org/api/v2 did)

pre_scouted_dataset_verification.match_assessment: DATASET_MISMATCH_FOR_SHAPE (partial): the Dryad table is horn LENGTH vs BODY MASS (ontogenetic allometry). It contains the claim's taxa (Ovis, Capra) but no horn-shape variables at all - no spiral angle, whorl ratio, cone semi-angle, torsion, curvature or centreline. It therefore cannot test the geometric content of T1917-031 (logarithmic spiral on a cone, species differing in spiral constant and torsion) and is NOT used to drive the verdict. It is vendored and SHA-pinned only as the registry-named dataset and is reported as a labelled, non-shape analogue in the script output.
pre_scouted_dataset_verification.fallback_authorised_by_override: Thompson's own 1917 figures from the pinned IA scan ongrowthform1917thom (printed page = leaf - 20) are the second dataset option named in the override, and the registry row sets digitize_1917_figures=true. These figures ARE shape data for the claim's species and are the primary test data here, together with a CC-licensed photograph of a real Ovis ammon horn.

primary_tests: T1: outer-edge log-spiral fit (free pole) on Fig. 320 Ovis ammon and on the real Argali horn; report alpha, whorl ratio, Pearson r of ln(rho) vs theta, RMSE
T2: model comparison log-spiral vs Archimedean spiral vs circle (AIC) - negative control is the circle (alpha = 90 deg, no gnomonic growth)
T3: gnomonic self-similarity - horn breadth across the whorl must scale with the same exponent k as the edge radius
T4: species difference - Capra sinaitica (Fig. 319) vs Ovis ammon (Fig. 320) spiral angles against Thompson's stated < 70 deg vs ~75 deg
verdict_plan.untested_here: torsion / St Venant anticlastic ring boundaries (needs 3D surface data); helical pitch between Argali species (needs frontal + lateral orthographic pairs)
